title: Isolate compromised employee workstation
description: Disconnect host WS-FIN-042 from the corporate network using endpoint agent isolation to prevent further lateral movement.

title: Disable affected user account
description: Revoke active session tokens and disable Active Directory account for finance@company.com.

title: Reset exposed credentials in AD
description: Force password change and rotate Kerberos Ticket Granting Service (TGS) keys for compromised service accounts.

title: Block malicious sender domain
description: Add acc0unting-dept.com to perimeter email gateway blocklist and purge existing messages from user inboxes.

title: Block malicious file hash
description: Distribute global EDR block rule for SHA-256 hash of Invoice_Q4_2024_Payroll.docm.

title: Disable suspicious PowerShell execution
description: Enforce constrained language mode and block encoded command execution on all workstation group policies.

title: Apply critical security patches
description: Deploy KB5036980 patch to resolve active directory credential extraction vulnerabilities.

title: Review Active Directory permissions
description: Audit delegation rights, adminSDHolder configuration, and identify excessive privileges on service accounts.

title: Restrict lateral movement via SMB
description: Implement firewall rules to block workstation-to-workstation SMB (port 445) communication.

title: Rotate service account credentials
description: Generate new high-entropy passwords for database-facing application service accounts.

title: Scan affected file servers
description: Trigger deep antivirus and heuristic scan of files changed in FS-01 shared directories in the last 24 hours.

title: Review data access logs
description: Examine DB transaction logs for unusual SELECT query volumes or data dumps matching the compromised host window.
